objective: Find out whether the chkdsk rune app can now compile for 32-bit Windows (i686-pc-windows-msvc) with a newer rune revision.
scope: Copy the tree of origin/main (git -C /home/user/chkdsk archive origin/main | tar -x -C /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-chkdsk/6d301693-1f05-56b7-955a-cbe3996284b5/scratchpad/i686-probe) into /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-chkdsk/6d301693-1f05-56b7-955a-cbe3996284b5/scratchpad/i686-probe; it pins rune git rev 757bcb1d1da1b3f80484f36ef610b83ddbcc6003
Rune repo https://github.com/anomalyco/rune default branch dev
constraints: In the probe copy only: run cargo xwin check --target i686-pc-windows-msvc with the current pin and record the errors; then change the pin to the latest rune dev commit (git ls-remote https://github.com/anomalyco/rune refs/heads/dev), cargo update -p rune (and its git siblings), and run the same check again; also run cargo xwin check --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc with the latest rev to see whether the app still compiles against it
Do not touch /home/user/chkdsk, /home/user/chkdsk-port or /home/user/chkdsk-release; no git writes

Report in under 200 words: rune revs tried, exit codes, the error count and first error locations for i686, whether the newest rev builds x86_64; logs in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-chkdsk/6d301693-1f05-56b7-955a-cbe3996284b5/scratchpad/logs/i686-*.log

criteria.text: Reports i686 check results for the pinned and the latest rune rev with exit codes
